sloka: ददर्श अदूरतः तस्य तरुण आदित्य संनिभम् ।पाण्डुर अभ्र घन प्रख्यम् चन्द्र मण्डल संनिभम् ॥३-५-८॥
transliteration: dadarśa adūrataḥ tasya taruṇa āditya saṁnibham ।pāṇḍura abhra ghana prakhyam candra maṇḍala saṁnibham ॥3-5-8॥

translations.english: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.
